body: In my newest book, The Great Spiritual Migration , I write that “One new generation of children and youth can bring about a new day in Christian faith.” I reference the fantastic work that Faith Forward is doing to be part of this great spiritual migration among children and youth. If you’re someone who cares about kids and teenagers and you want to re-imagine ministry and faith formation with young people, then join me at the 2017 Faith Forward gathering, May 22-24 in Chicago . This highly creative, collaborative, and ecumenical event is filled with vitality and hope and I’m proud to be part of it. Head over to http://faith-forward.net for more information and use MCLAREN as a discount code to save $25 on registration until March 5 .
